title: WebSocket provider destroy() returns a promise that is neither awaited nor caught

evidence.note: Claude verification: declared destroy(): Promise<void> at :35. With no unhandledRejection handler (AUD-BUY-005) a rejection would end the process.

sibling_sites_checked: removeWsProvider is the only destroy site in the slice.
severity_rationale: S3: destroy rarely rejects, but the failure mode is process exit with positions open.
recommendation: Catch and log the rejection. No behaviour change. Phase 29 (S2-S4). Nothing is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
